brief: A small closed box with a lid to keep a pack of kitchen matches dry.
costSource: token-equivalent at Muse Spark Open shared rates, info only: the Dedicated Endpoint bills GPU seconds while up (.spend/modal-dedicated.jsonl)

requirements.evidence: 2-storey hex base column (piece:0,0,0;full + piece:0,0,1;full) capped on all 12 open faces with caps, forming enclosed volume ~190x170mm footprint, 2 levels high
Full top cover cover:0,0,1;full;top acts as removable lid closing top face

requirements.requirement: Keeps pack of kitchen matches dry
requirements.evidence: Closed geometry with top cover and caps provides enclosed storage that limits dust/splash ingress and keeps matches dry in normal indoor use; configurator does not model sealing/waterproofing, and parts are 3D-printed in user-chosen material with no waterproof, food-safe or heat rating - cannot claim watertight or dishwasher-safe. Shape helps only.

finish.summary: Built a compact 2-level hex box closed with solid caps on all sides and a full top cover as lid. Provides an enclosed compartment for a pack of kitchen matches. As with all Hex Cluster builds, weather/waterproofing is not verified and depends on print material/quality - presented as dry indoor storage, not a certified waterproof container.

events.text: A dry box for your kitchen matches — I'll put together a small lidded case.
